# Beltway Demolition

> Beltway Demolition is a demolition and site clearance contractor working across Maryland, Washington DC and Virginia. It takes structures down, clears what is left and hands back a site ready for its next use. It is backed by WMB LLC, which holds a construction contractor licence in the State of Maryland.

## Company facts

- Name: Beltway Demolition
- Website: https://beltwaydemo.com/
- Business type: demolition and site clearance contractor
- Backing and licensing: backed by WMB LLC (https://wmbre.com), which holds a construction contractor licence in the State of Maryland; licence documentation and certificates of insurance available on request
- Service area: Maryland, Washington DC, Virginia and the surrounding Mid-Atlantic
- Services: demolition (full, selective and interior); environmental and abatement; site clearance and grading; asset recovery and recycling; permits and project management; hauling and disposal
- Typical clients: property owners, general contractors, commercial and industrial clients, municipal and institutional clients
- Phone: +1 (703) 861-5354
- Email: info@beltwaydemo.com

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Beltway Demolition do?

Beltway Demolition is a demolition and site clearance contractor working across Maryland, Washington DC and Virginia. We handle demolition, environmental and abatement work, site clearance and grading, asset recovery and recycling, permits and project management, and hauling and disposal, so one contractor takes a site from standing structure to buildable ground.

### Where does Beltway Demolition work?

Across Maryland, Washington DC, Virginia and the surrounding Mid-Atlantic, including Baltimore, Annapolis, Washington DC, Montgomery and Prince George’s counties, Northern Virginia (Arlington, Alexandria, Fairfax and Loudoun), Frederick and Western Maryland, Southern Maryland and the Eastern Shore. If your site is outside that area, ask anyway. For the right job we travel well past the map.

### Is Beltway Demolition licensed and insured?

Beltway Demolition is backed by WMB LLC, which holds a construction contractor licence in the State of Maryland. Certificates of insurance are issued to the client and any additional insureds before mobilisation, and licence documentation is available with any quote.

### How do I get a demolition quote?

Send the site address, a few photos and what you need gone, by phone on +1 (703) 861-5354 or by email to info@beltwaydemo.com. We walk the site with you, then send a written quote with a fixed scope and a fixed price, including disposal, permits and any salvage credit.

### Do you handle demolition permits and utility disconnects?

Yes. Demolition permit applications, utility disconnect coordination and regulatory notifications are closed out before a machine is on site.

### What happens to the debris?

Debris, concrete and scrap are hauled to permitted and licensed facilities, and the disposal tickets and manifests are kept for your file. Structural steel and other salvage is recovered and sold, and its value comes off your invoice. Concrete is crushed and reused where practical.

### Do you demolish houses, garages and outbuildings?

Yes. We carry out full and partial structural demolition of residential, commercial and industrial buildings, including garages, outbuildings, barns and slabs, for property owners clearing a lot for sale, redevelopment or a new build.

### Can you do interior or selective demolition in an occupied building?

Yes. We carry out interior strip-outs in occupied buildings and work alongside live utilities and neighbouring structures.

### What does site clearance include after demolition?

Slab, footing and foundation removal, grubbing, stump and vegetation clearance, backfill, compaction and rough grading, and erosion and sediment control measures, leaving a parcel a surveyor and a builder can both work from.

### Can salvage reduce the cost of demolition?

Yes. Structural steel, non-ferrous metals, equipment, fixtures and architectural salvage are recovered and sold rather than dumped, and the value comes off your invoice. We can also provide recycling records for LEED or client reporting.

### Who does Beltway Demolition work for?

Property owners, general contractors, commercial and industrial clients, and municipal and institutional clients across Maryland, Washington DC and Virginia.
